text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... Good grief. Can't believe I 
overslept and ended up all the way out 
here.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Got some time before training, but... 
gotta make sure I don't fall asleep.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Same old scenery, no opponents to 
fight... ...This is such a lukewarm waste 
of time."

text_block_list.name: Gossiping Passenger
text_block_list.text:
“—And listen! They made a test-of-courage 
spot at the next station! Though 
apparently, it's super high risk...”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If you head home after enjoying that, 
your mind should be much clearer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sick and tired of the long commute, she 
ended up slacking off on her training like 
this...
